description: Redeem the code from a RepuTend invite email to join that company's team. Your key is yours and reaches every company whose team you join: redeemed on a connection that already sends your RepuTend key, the company joins that key and nothing else changes. Redeemed without your key, you get a new key, shown once, that replaces any earlier one on every connection, and connect says how to reconnect with it, so the person never types the key. Update the RepuTend connection you called this on (the one at connect.url), under its own name. In Codex (the CLI, the IDE extension, or the Codex view of the ChatGPT desktop app, which all read ~/.codex/config.toml): replace its entry in that file with connect.codex.toml yourself, or, if you cannot write the file, show the person the block to paste in place of the RepuTend entry; then the person restarts the client, since a running one reads the file only when it starts (the CLI: a new session; the IDE extension: Restart extension; the ChatGPT desktop app: quit and reopen it). ChatGPT's own chats, Chat or Work, never read that file. In Claude Code: remove the connection and add it again with the key, as connect.claude_code does for a connection named reputend. In Claude Desktop, which you cannot configure: show the person connect.claude_desktop to paste into its settings file (connect.claude_desktop.config_file) in place of the RepuTend entry under mcpServers, whatever its name; then they restart Claude Desktop. Any other client sends connect.header. A code works once and lasts 7 days. (capability: invite.redeem)
name: redeem_invite
